short: Carries the gathered data out of the company.
analogy: Carries the bag out of the house.

solutionNotes.dlp: Doesn’t let confidential data be quietly sent outside.
solutionNotes.ndr: Spots unusually large or regular data transfers.
solutionNotes.ngfw: Limits where and over which protocols data can be sent.
solutionNotes.cnapp: Spots cloud resources that were shared with a foreign account.
